SafetyAgent.text: The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are recorded accurately to prevent data loss or corruption.
SafetyAgent.rationale: Accurate transaction recording is crucial for maintaining reliability in financial reporting.

SafetyAgent.text: The system shall implement double-entry bookkeeping principles to ensure integrity and prevent discrepancies.
SafetyAgent.rationale: Following double-entry principles helps identify and mitigate errors in financial data.

SafetyAgent.text: The system shall maintain an audit trail of all transactions, retaining records for at least 7 years.
SafetyAgent.rationale: An audit trail enhances accountability and supports compliance with financial regulations.

SafetyAgent.text: The system shall provide error handling mechanisms to manage and recover from faults during transaction processing.
SafetyAgent.rationale: Fault tolerance is essential to maintain system reliability during unexpected failures.

SafetyAgent.text: The system shall support safe degradation, ensuring that users can access essential functionalities even during partial outages.
SafetyAgent.rationale: Safe degradation protects user access to critical functions, enhancing overall system reliability.

SafetyAgent.text: The system shall validate currency conversions to ensure accuracy and prevent financial discrepancies.
SafetyAgent.rationale: Accurate currency conversion is vital for maintaining the reliability of financial records in multiple currencies.

SafetyAgent.text: The system shall perform regular backups of financial data to prevent loss in case of system failure.
SafetyAgent.rationale: Regular backups are essential to ensure data recovery and maintain system reliability.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are processed within 2 seconds to optimize responsiveness.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: Fast transaction processing enhances user experience and maintains operational efficiency.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall support concurrent processing of at least 100 users to ensure adequate throughput.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: High user concurrency is essential for performance in a multi-user bookkeeping environment.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall utilize efficient data structures to minimize memory usage by 30% compared to traditional methods.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: Resource optimization through efficient data handling directly impacts performance efficiency.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall generate financial reports in under 5 seconds for datasets up to 10,000 transactions.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: Rapid report generation is critical for timely decision-making in financial management.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall implement caching for frequently accessed data to reduce latency by at least 50%.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: Caching enhances performance by decreasing the time taken to retrieve commonly used information.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall ensure that currency conversion operations complete within 3 seconds for real-time transactions.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: Efficient currency conversion is vital for maintaining performance during financial transactions involving multiple currencies.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall maintain an audit trail that logs each transaction with a maximum logging delay of 1 second.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: Timely logging of transactions is crucial for accountability and the overall integrity of performance.

GreenAgent.text: The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing by using efficient algorithms and data structures.
GreenAgent.rationale: This ensures lower energy usage, contributing to overall sustainability.

GreenAgent.text: The system shall implement cloud-based solutions to reduce the carbon footprint associated with local server maintenance.
GreenAgent.rationale: Cloud solutions typically have lower carbon footprints than traditional on-premises systems.

GreenAgent.text: The system shall support document digitization to reduce paper usage by at least 80%.
GreenAgent.rationale: Reducing paper consumption directly decreases resource impact, enhancing sustainability.

GreenAgent.text: The system shall track the lifecycle resource impact of accounting features to identify areas for improvement.
GreenAgent.rationale: Understanding resource impact helps in making informed decisions to enhance sustainability.

GreenAgent.text: The system shall provide users with sustainability reports showing energy and resource consumption metrics.
GreenAgent.rationale: Transparency in sustainability metrics encourages more efficient usage and decision-making.

GreenAgent.text: The system shall enable users to offset carbon emissions from transactions through integrated carbon credit options.
GreenAgent.rationale: Offering carbon offset options helps users actively contribute to sustainability efforts.

GreenAgent.text: The system shall ensure compliance with sustainability regulations and standards relevant to financial systems.
GreenAgent.rationale: Compliance with regulations is essential for sustainable business practices and legal adherence.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are encrypted during transmission and storage.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: Encryption protects sensitive financial data from unauthorized access and breaches.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict user permissions based on their roles.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: Role-based access control minimizes the risk of unauthorized access to sensitive financial information.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall maintain an immutable audit trail of all transactions for a minimum of 5 years.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: An immutable audit trail ensures accountability and traceability of all financial activities.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall validate data input to prevent unauthorized or malicious data entry.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: Data validation helps maintain the integrity of financial records by filtering out invalid inputs.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall support two-factor authentication for all users accessing financial data.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: Two-factor authentication enhances security by requiring additional verification for user access.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall log all user access and modifications to data, retaining logs for review.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: Logging access and modifications allows for auditing and monitoring of user actions for security purposes.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall ensure that users can only access data relevant to their assigned accounts and categories.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: Limiting data access based on user roles protects sensitive information from unauthorized viewing.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The system shall ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations and standards to guarantee legal accountability.
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: This requirement ensures that the system operates within the legal framework, preventing potential legal violations.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The bookkeeping system shall implement user access controls to ensure that only authorized personnel can modify transactions.
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: This prevents unauthorized alterations, promoting accountability and protecting sensitive financial data.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The system shall log all financial transactions with timestamps and user identifiers to maintain a transparent audit trail.
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: An audit trail is crucial for accountability and enables tracking of changes for compliance purposes.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The system shall provide functionalities to detect and alert users about potential financial discrepancies or fraud.
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: This feature supports fair practices by enabling timely identification of irregularities safeguarding user interests.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The system shall support reporting that complies with local and international accounting standards to ensure fairness in financial reporting.
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: Compliance with accounting standards ensures the integrity and fairness of financial reports provided by the system.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The system shall include mechanisms for users to report ethical concerns or violations confidentially.
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: This encourages accountability and social responsibility by allowing stakeholders to voice concerns without fear of retaliation.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The system shall provide multi-currency support with transparent exchange rates to ensure fairness in international transactions.
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: Transparent currency conversion promotes equitable treatment of users engaging in cross-border transactions.
